scope: Cut the T-20260902-058 top-50 FP pp_pre.sig -> slot_result_r cone by registering round_pack p1/p2 across IT_PREP -> IT_PACK in FP_ITER, while preserving T-056 IT_ALIGN/IT_ADD and all architectural response semantics.

implementation.summary: Added IT_PACK and pack_mid/pack_mid_lo/pack_mid_hi fp_round_mid_t registers. IT_PREP now captures round_pack_p1 and IT_PACK alone performs p2 and raises iter_done for ordinary pp_pre operations (ADD/SUB/MUL/FMA/SCVTF/UCVTF/FCVT). The existing iterative IT_FIN p1 path now enters the same IT_PACK p2 state. round_pack_p1 scans ordinary lead_valid=0 pre.sig instead of treating finite nonzero values as zero. Added B1 pause contract probes for ordinary, FDIV and FSQRT IT_PACK paths plus pause kill/reset priority.

state_boundary.it_prep: For uses_round_pack_pre, capture complete fp_round_mid_t into pack_mid*; no result or iter_done.
state_boundary.it_pack: Consume registered pack_mid* with round_pack_p2 and present result/fpsr_flags/iter_done; clear payload on the following state-machine edge.
state_boundary.iterative_div_sqrt: IT_FIN remains the p1 capture stage for div_pre/sqrt_pre and transitions to IT_PACK; iterative latency is unchanged.
state_boundary.reset_kill: it_state_r=IT_IDLE and all pack_mid* registers are zero on reset or iter_kill.
state_boundary.valid_drop: IT_PREP/IT_PACK return to IT_IDLE and clear pack_mid* without iter_done/result.
state_boundary.iter_pause: State and payload hold; IT_PREP does not capture and IT_PACK suppresses p2/iter_done until pause is released. Direct TB uses a bounded hierarchical wait preceded by an unconditional posedge+#1 NBA fence for ordinary ADD, FDIV.S and FSQRT.S IT_PACK (it_state_r=4'd10, with it_fin_valid_r distinguishing iterative payloads), holds two cycles while changing live operands, then checks one original result/flags pulse.
state_boundary.architectural_commit: No architectural state is changed; existing slot capture, response hold, and commit path are unchanged.

latency.pause_nominal_latency: unchanged; paused cycles are additive and are not part of the nominal table
latency.pause_locator: unconditional posedge+#1 NBA fence, then bounded hierarchical IT_PACK state wait; fixed prep cycle counts are not used

semantics.special_priority: NaN, zero, Inf and finite paths use the existing fp_pre helpers; p1/p2 only split round/pack.
semantics.fpcr_fpsr: DN/FZ/RMode and FPCR snapshot behavior preserved; p2 flags are the same p1 input_flags plus round flags.
semantics.raw_bits: IEEE raw-bit payload, quieting, overflow/subnormal and zero sign behavior preserved.
semantics.slot_response: Single outstanding transaction, per-slot NEON order, held response and commit sequencing unchanged.
